en: Black‑and‑white image that appears staged in a historical or folkloric style: a woman in traditional dress is stepping down from an old horse‑drawn mail coach while a man in a bowler hat and formal clothing assists her and holds a large framed document or poster. Behind them is the coach with large wheels and a flag on top that seems to contain printed text, suggesting a postal or ceremonial setting.
